name: Start a flood action group
does: Bring neighbours together to share local knowledge and agree a flood plan.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Protect the street together
does: Coordinate property flood resilience surveys and suitable measures as a street-level scheme.
lead: Local authority and qualified resilience surveyors
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Shared drainage & rain gardens
does: Explore sustainable drainage (SuDS) to slow surface-water runoff. A drainage survey must establish suitability.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026

name: Warning & neighbour buddy scheme
does: Sign up for official flood warnings and agree how to check on neighbours who need support.
source: ARKRA product demo assumption · team brief, 8 November 2026
